about: The probe reviewer's recorded fixtures for probe:p345 (docs/method/HOW-WE-BUILT-THIS.md rule 9). No run of probe:p345 existed when they were written, so each is composed in the exact shapes the run reads: the lines ios/TortieUITests/P316DriveUITests.swift prints (step, seq, a dump's elements with id, label and frame, a macs line's label, found and tabs) with what build/p345/probe-p345.mjs adds as it reads them (receivedAt, doors, records; a mark's markAt, markDoneAt, recordsAt and recordsAfter), and build/p345/sni-relay.mjs's connection log. `--grader-self-test` reads each drive through the SAME reader the run calls, then the grader, and each grader's readings straight; `want` is the verdict.

drives.name: honest: each Mac its own lists, the Terminal closed with the switch
broken: the first Mac's Terminal still polls on its kept line after the switch, no new connection
broken: a new connection to the first Mac after the switch
broken: the second Mac draws the first Mac's rows
broken: no Macs tab named after the first Mac with two kept
unreadable: lines with no request records at the marks
honest: the sender chosen, its session open, the other Mac's Terminal kept
broken: after the tap the sender is not on screen (no tab named after it)
unreadable: the drive stopped at the alert (no banner)
broken: the other Mac's Sessions lost its Terminal
broken: the tap opened another session
honest: the Mac on screen read at once, the silent one held and named after 15 s
